scope: Harness validation only; cold pipeline, no full scale acceptance or leak conclusion

run.label: harness-10
notes: NIMA is a sequential diagnostic sidecar on every cache miss; never enters production ranking. Total wall time includes it.
Stage sums overlap across 2 workers; do not subtract sums from wall time.
Cache hits are persisted valid DONE results plus existing preview/thumbnail, not an inferred total-minus-success count.
Interruption uses production cancel at a safe boundary, closes the process, then starts a new process. Not an abrupt power-loss test.

memory.note: No leak conclusion. Node RSS includes workers; Electron working sets approximate RSS and may double-count shared pages. ExifTool/orchestrator excluded.
